name: O'Mok

overview.desc: O'Mok is a great support for Magic allies, not only prodiving Magic Attack boost but also CC Immunity & Damage Immunity. Her role transforms at T6 to become a strong AOE DPS.

tips.name: HP Alteration
tips.body: Sets the target's HP to a specified amount. Will not change the target's HP if their current HP is lower than that amount.

tips.name: Guardian Spirit
tips.body: When the buff expires after 2 turn(s), the target gains All Damage Immunity and Crowd Control Immunity for 2 turn(s). If the buff expires before 2 turn(s) have passed, the follow-up effect will not activate. However, if the buff is forcibly expired due to Buff Duration Reduction, the follow-up effect will be activated.

tips.name: Debuff Removal
tips.body: Removes debuffs in the order they were applied.

lines: - Deals damage equal to 70% of Magic Attack 7 time(s). (Damage increases by up to 2% proportional to the target's current HP)

enhancement.effect: Increases Damage: To 80% of Magic Attack plus 9% of the target's Max HP.

lines: - 100% chance to inflict Weakness Hit Chance Reduction and Defense Reduction upon falling in battle. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)] [Once per Battle]

tips.name: Camouflage
tips.body:
Cannot become the target of a single-target attack. Attacks and debuffs received while Camouflaged are guaranteed to miss.
If the only attackable heroes on a team are Camouflaged, Camouflage will be removed from all heroes on that team.

tips.name: Guts
tips.body: Survives with 1 HP upon taking lethal damage for the first time.

tips.name: Barrier
tips.body: Absorbs damage equal to the barrier value.

enhancement.effect: Increases Effect: Magic Attack Boost to 25%.

tx.effect: Adds Effect: Grants a Barrier equal to 155% of the caster's Magic Attack upon triggering Guts. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]

why_by_stat.Crush: Mainly useful in PVP. Reduces the enemy’s Block Rate 1%-for-1%, making it easier for O'Mok to land Critical Hits and deal more damage to tanky enemies.
why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by O'Mok by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"Fruit, spirit, elementalist... Who cares? You're just a rascally kid, so stop calling yourself part of a tree and just introduce yourself as O'Mok from now on, got it?"

After the battle at the Mystic Tree, the Night Crows took a keen interest in the young O'Mok when she demonstrated her extraordinary purifying powers by instantly breaking Karl Heron's curse. Subsequently, she officially joined the Night Crows' ranks and received a gift from Karl Heron to commemorate the event: a nameplate etched with the name "O'Mok," made just for her.

lore: O'Mok is a girl born from the fruit of a Mystic Tree. Believing there must be a reason the Mystic Tree had borne fruit in the form of a human child, the villagers who protected the tree —including Karon— raised her with the utmost care and affection. However, the villagers decided that revealing the truth of her origins would only cause confusion to a child so young and did not disclose her true identity. Then, one day, the Power of Destruction caused Black Rifts to tear open throughout the forest, and monsters emerged from these rifts and attacked the village in search of a single target — O'Mok. Because of this tragedy, O'Mok learned the truth of her birth and became tormented by guilt, believing the villagers had been slaughtered because of her. Fortunately, Karl Heron —who had come to rescue her— helped heal her emotional wounds, and she in turn lifted the curse on his eyepatch that had long afflicted him. Afterward, at Karl Heron's behest, she joined the Night Crows and began to hone her talents as an elementalist.
